title: An etale algebra over a field is a finite product of finite separable extensions
statement: Let $k$ be a field and $C$ a commutative $k$-algebra such that $\operatorname{Spec}C\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism], [def-weil-affine-spectrum] (equivalently, by [lem-weil-pbc-etale-ring-map-iff-etale-affine], $k\to C$ is an etale ring map in the sense of Stacks, Algebra, Definition 00U1). Then there are an integer $n\ge0$, fields $L_1,\dots,L_n$, each a field extension of $k$ [def-pc-field-extension] which is finite ($\dim_kL_j<\infty$) and separable algebraic [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension], and an isomorphism of $k$-algebras $C\cong L_1\times\cdots\times L_n$ (for $n=0$ the zero ring).
